description: Les citernes de lutte contre les incendies sur l'île de Port-Cros is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by BUREAU DE RECHERCHES GÉOLOGIQUES ET MINIÈRES. Location of fire tanks contributing to fire defence on the island of Port-Cros. Water is the common extinguishing agent of forest fires. Its permanence is essential for the effectiveness of the terrestrial control system. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Fire fighting tanks on the island of Port-Cros" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Risque d'incendie, Port-Cros. The listing shows 2017-08-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
